topic: Growth currency, first field expansion, and Memory mastery
currentUserGoal: Call the permanent Memory currency Growth, make the first 1x1-to-2x2 field expansion cost 250 Run Touches, and make completing a ranked skill feel special with a fanfare and persistent gold mastery treatment.
workCompleted: Renamed the player-facing permanent currency from Grass Touches to Growth throughout the field HUD, Memory Grove, title screen, semantic controls, debug tools, status copy, and design documentation.
Preserved the internal grassTouches save field so existing browser saves remain compatible.
Renamed the run-local production resource in player-facing copy to Field Growth so it cannot be confused with permanent Growth.
Reduced only the first 1x1-to-2x2 run-local field expansion from 500 to 250 Run Touches; later expansion prices still double from 1000 onward.
Added a final-rank mastery fanfare for every multi-rank Memory: milestone audio, a bounded gold ring and spark burst, icon/frame/glow pulses, and a temporary MASTERED banner.
Added persistent mastered styling after the fanfare: gold frame tint, gold glow, gold rank pips, gold title/status copy, and MASTERED detail and semantic states.
Kept one-time unlock Memories in their normal remembered style; the gold mastery state is reserved for skills with multiple ranks.
Fixed maxed helper-rank semantic labels so they announce mastered instead of exposing a nonexistent next purchase cost.
Returned the local playtest save to a clean Run 1 after browser verification.
verificationRun: npm run check passed: ESLint, Knip, 159 Vitest tests across 18 files, strict TypeScript, and the Vite production build.
Focused ecosystem system and Memory tests passed: 75 tests across 2 files.
Deterministic tests verify the expansion-cost ladder starts at 250, then continues at 1000, 2000, 4000, and higher, and verify the distinct Growth and Field Growth labels.

Desktop 1280x720 browser verification purchased the tenth Clockwork Nozzle rank and visibly confirmed the gold burst, MASTERED banner, persistent gold node treatment, gold detail treatment, and semantic mastered state.
The desktop mastery burst remained bounded at 19 active tweens at its peak and returned to zero after completion.
Browser verification unlocked the 2x2 field Memory, confirmed the live expansion control was disabled below 250 Run Touches, enabled at 250, spent all 250, and produced a real 2x2 field.

Phone-layout 390x844 browser verification showed the Memory Grove and detail panel stacking without overlap; the sampled snapshot held 144 FPS, zero frame spikes, zero full-field scans, and zero active tweens while idle.
Browser logs contained no warnings or errors.
knownIssues: The debug panel overlays content on a 390x844 viewport when expanded; this remains confined to the debugPanel route.
Growth is the permanent Memory currency while Field Growth remains a run-local production stock; the UI now distinguishes them, but hands-on testing should confirm the distinction is intuitive.
The first expansion is now significantly cheaper than the second by design: 250 Run Touches versus 1000.
The unrelated docs/CODEX_GITHUB_SETUP_GUIDE.md remains untracked and was not modified.
nextRecommendedSteps: Hands-on test several natural ranked-skill completions to judge whether the mastery fanfare duration and audio weight feel satisfying.
Test the first 2x2 expansion in normal play and tune the 250 Run Touches target only from observed pacing.
Review whether Growth and Field Growth remain sufficiently distinct once more production systems are visible.
Push, deploy, and synchronize with the Mac only when requested.
doNotRevert: Do not rename the internal grassTouches save field without a migration; only its player-facing name changed to Growth.
Do not call the run-local production stock Growth in player-facing copy; use Field Growth.
Do not restore the first 1x1-to-2x2 expansion to 500 Run Touches unless balance testing supports it.
Do not apply gold mastery styling to one-time unlock Memories; reserve it for completed ranked skills.
Do not replace the bounded mastery effects with persistent particles or hot-path animation work.
Do not include docs/CODEX_GITHUB_SETUP_GUIDE.md without explicit user direction.
